description: This is a Java integration test class for JWT token verification, specifically testing various scenarios related to JWT token handling such as invalid tokens, expired tokens, and successful token validation in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifierIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for JWT token verification endpoints in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfIncorrectRefreshTokenPassed
methods.description: Tests that the refresh token endpoint returns an unauthorized error when an incorrect refresh token is provided.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfTokenNotPassed
methods.description: Validates that accessing a protected resource without a token results in an unauthorized error.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfTokenInvalidTokenPassed
methods.description: Checks that an invalid JWT token results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldAllowRequestIfTokenIsValid
methods.description: Verifies that a valid JWT token grants access to the protected resource.

methods.name: shouldGetUnauthenticatedIfTokenIsExpired
methods.description: Ensures that an expired token results in an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldReturnJwtAndRefreshTokenWhenProvidedCorrectRefreshToken
methods.description: Tests that providing a valid refresh token returns new JWT and refresh tokens.
